versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-douyin-competitor-intel-source:

- Provides four key capabilities: Douyin keyword search, creator posts fetch, video comments retrieval, and real-time hotlist query.
- Enables structured JSON output for content research, competitor analysis, sentiment monitoring, and trend tracking.
- Includes detailed intent recognition and argument inference rules to map user requests to the right command.
- Enforces strict token management and privacy compliance—no hardcoding, all auth via environment variable.
- Clearly defines error handling, command usage, and output specification for robust, automated operation.
